title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (5/20): Building the Grand View Garden
note_en: In 贾府上下都欢喜得不得了 "the whole Jia household was overjoyed," 得 comes after the adjective and introduces how intense the feeling is: 不得了 means "to an extreme." English uses an adverb in front ("extremely happy"); Chinese puts the degree after the adjective with 得. You'll see the same pattern in 好得很 and 累得要命.
